title: IPOGrid IPO Calendar & Filing Research
description: IPO calendar, SEC filings, deal terms, and IPO news research via the IPOGrid MCP server.
summary: IPO calendar, SEC filings, deal terms, and IPO news research via the IPOGrid MCP server.
offersHint: IPO calendar, SEC filings, deal terms, and IPO news research via the IPOGrid MCP server. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://ipogrid.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_chart
toolsPreview.description: Build an aggregated IPO chart and return its data plus canonical embed, page, and API URLs. Use this instead of hand-building chart URLs. Anonymous requests are quota-limited and may clamp a 52-week range to 26 weeks or a daily bucket to weekly unless the explicit date window is at most 31 days.

toolsPreview.name: list_companies
toolsPreview.description: Discover IPOGrid companies and active deals with cursor pagination and market, issuer-kind, freshness, or proceeds filters. Use get_company after selecting an issuer. Anonymous requests return at most 10 rows and omit consensus enrichment.

toolsPreview.name: get_company
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one issuer by SEC CIK after discovery with list_companies. Optional enrichments add terms and research context; anonymous requests allow only latest_terms, classification, and news.

toolsPreview.name: list_news
toolsPreview.description: List recent IPO-company news, optionally filtered by SEC CIK. Use this for a news feed; use get_company with news for broader issuer context. Anonymous requests return at most 10 rows and omit full content.
